summary: Fixes automatic tag generation in the Tag dressup so paths made of many short edges get tags distributed evenly instead of bunched on one long segment, plus linter cleanups; no properties, task-panel controls, defaults, or preferences change.

pages.reason: Path/Dressup/Tags.py: generateTags() now falls back to short edges when too few edges are at least 2x tag width and stops once enough tags are assigned; restores documented even spread, no user-facing option or property changes. Gui/Tags.py hunks are f-string and import cleanups only.

meta.title: CAM: DressupTag - Fix for path with short edges
